summary: Iteration 3: All 4 NEW features verified end-to-end on backend + mobile web preview (390x844). Backend pytest (test_iteration3_features.py) 11/11 PASS covering likes (auth + toggle on/off + persistence via GET), comments (public GET, auth POST, user_name persistence), and personal notes (auth GET/PUT, upsert overwrite, empty string for non-existent note). Frontend E2E: home shows calculator-card and navigates to /calculator; mode-flour and mode-dough toggle; calc-amount + calc-hydration recompute (amount=1000 flour, h=70 -> Farine=1000g, Eau=700g); toggle-levain reveals calc-levain; mode-dough with amount=1900 correctly back-solves flour ~984g; recipe detail like-btn toggles from '0 j'aime' -> '1 j'aime'; segment-community shows note-input (saves via save-note and persists after page reload) and comment-input + comment-send (added comment appears immediately in list); segment-steps shows step 02 'Repos 1h' with a 'Lancer le minuteur (60 min)' chip (testID timer-step-1) that opens a floating timer-bar with timer-toggle (pause/resume) and timer-stop (dismisses bar). No react-native deprecated packages or SafeAreaView issues detected. Only console noise: 'shadow*' style props deprecated warning from RN Web (already-known cosmetic, not blocking).

issues: React Native Web logs 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Source likely TimerBar.tsx elevation/shadow* usage. Non-blocking cosmetic warning.

action_items: OPTIONAL: replace shadow* style props with boxShadow-equivalent (or use Platform.select) in TimerBar.tsx to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
OPTIONAL: expose the total-count of likes on the recipe list card so users see popularity without opening detail (not requested by spec).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_note returns {content: ''} when no doc exists (good, prevents 404).
toggle_like recomputes count with count_documents after upsert/delete (correct and race-safe enough for single-user actions).
recipe/[id].tsx parseDuration correctly extracts hours + minutes (e.g. '1h 30min' -> 5400s) and only shows the timer chip when a duration is present.
calculator.tsx correctly implements baker's percentages: totalPct = 100+h+s+y+l; flour = amount/(totalPct/100) in dough mode; verified numerically.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of new-feature flows (calculator, like, comments, note persistence, timer start/pause/stop)
